summary: A 1v1 on Quicksilver against one unnamed Armada player in the user's lobby, lost to a Pawn rush in under four and a half minutes. The hands started the lab at 0:11 from the default text, before the player's first packet, and that packet (0:12) put three extractors ahead of any generator. The energy store was empty from 0:33 to 2:26, the first constructor took 80 s, and the first generator, wind although the player had asked for solar twice, began at 1:56. His first Pawn reached our base at 1:51-1:58 with no soldier or turret of ours on the map: one to three Pawns took all four extractors between 2:03 and 2:20, and two killed the lab at 2:38 while the commander stood about 450 away building a windmill, with no energy for its D-gun. A second lab (3:12-3:28) made two Pawns and died at 4:07 to seven Pawns, and the commander, walking north-west, was at 4% health at 4:26. He won with Pawns alone off a solar opening and told us in chat he chose solar because the wind was low that game.

root.what: The lab was placed at 0:11 with no generator standing: the hands played the default text ('extractor, then the lab, then two generators') before the player's first packet, and the 0:12 packet asked for three extractors before a solar. From 0:33 the store was empty, everything crawled until 2:26, and no soldier existed when his Pawns came at 1:51.

A stronger opening is generators at once: a solar costs no energy to build on an empty store, as the person of the game before said ('solar is better when you are out of e'). Matt's Quicksilver line is two extractors, three windmills, then the lab at 0:33.

their_play: One Armada player, unnamed and unrated. In his words he opened on solar ('I built solar due to the low wind random chance', 2:45) and sent Pawns from the first lab. The first one was in our base at 1:51 (unidentified at (3412, 2577)) and 1:58 (an armpw at (3543, 1982) beside spot_8). By 2:12 three Pawns were in our half, and one to three of them killed four extractors in 17 s (2:03-2:20). Two sat on the lab and killed it at 2:38, unopposed. He had 7 Pawns at 3:49-3:52 and 9-10 at 4:17, and they killed the second lab and both its Pawns. We killed 2 of his Pawns at 2:29/2:32 and 7 more from 3:33 to 4:26, five of them at 4:18-4:26 as the commander left (486 metal seen dead against our 1,862). We never saw a building of his, and his base never appeared in the picture (minutes.py 'his first factory seen: never'). He also coached in chat: solar over wind when the wind is low, and asked whether we can see the wind speed.

bears_on.note: This game is the source of 'I built solar due to the low wind random chance' (opponent, 2:45). The block's games key lists 'human-2', but two batches carry that name: this one is the ledger's human-4, and 1790046088-human-2 is human-3.
The reason for the third solar is energy for a fast constructor. Here a constructor was the lab's first unit with no generator at all, and it took 80 s (0:30-1:50) on an empty store.
Seen from the receiving side: his first Pawns crossed by 1:51-1:58 and took every extractor and the lab by 2:38 because nothing of ours stood against them.
The commander built extractors and windmills 550-600 from the lab at a crawl. At 2:24-2:38 it stood about 450 from the two Pawns killing the lab.

The reader's reading: from 0:33 to 2:26 the lab's constructor and the commander's extractors split an empty store, so nothing finished quickly. A priority on one consumer would have finished something.

lens.caveats: There is no truth file, so his numbers are floors (what we saw). pro_baseline was not run: Quicksilver has no cards. chat.jsonl attributes every line '?'. The record's chat events (player 0 the opponent, player 1 our Xyston) fix the speakers, but the opponent's name and rating are unknown. floor.py reads result '-' and minutes 0 on this old record; its e0% 56.2 and idle% 3.8 stand. The 3:55 friendly kill is the record's 'by' field only, and which weapon fired is unknown (the store was under 50, so probably not the D-gun). The game date is local time (-0400). Two claims are the reader's reading, both marked: the lab's second constructor as a words defect, and the walk-away as the only line left from 3:00.
